explication: MNN is a lightweight deep-learning framework for on-device inference and training, with MNN-LLM and MNN-Diffusion as model-runtime solutions built on its engine. The main workflow is to bring a supported model into an application, execute it through the runtime and a platform backend, and return results on-device; the repository also documents multimodal chat and local speech/avatar capabilities. The graph preserves these product branches and the sampled execution, memory, and model-schema layers. Some links describe README-documented capabilities; unsampled internals are not inferred as direct calls.
